tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search of The Korean Today articles, newest first. Korean keywords work best for the Korean edition; use lang for another edition or to get translated summaries.

lang.description: Language code. Edition codes (own articles): ko, en, fr, zh, ja, vi, th, id, lo, es, pt, ar, de, mn, ru. Any of the 87 AI summary languages (e.g. vi, th, hi, sw, zh-CN, pt-BR) returns Korean articles with a translated title and summary. Default ko.

section.description: Section slug from list_sections (e.g. society, economy, k-culture, technology).

tools.name: latest_articles
tools.description: Most recent articles, optionally by section and language.

lang.description: Language code. Edition codes (own articles): ko, en, fr, zh, ja, vi, th, id, lo, es, pt, ar, de, mn, ru. Any of the 87 AI summary languages (e.g. vi, th, hi, sw, zh-CN, pt-BR) returns Korean articles with a translated title and summary. Default ko.

section.description: Section slug from list_sections (e.g. society, economy, k-culture, technology).

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text and metadata of one article by id or URL. With lang, also returns the AI summary in that language and links to other language editions. Members-only articles return metadata only.

lang.description: Language code. Edition codes (own articles): ko, en, fr, zh, ja, vi, th, id, lo, es, pt, ar, de, mn, ru. Any of the 87 AI summary languages (e.g. vi, th, hi, sw, zh-CN, pt-BR) returns Korean articles with a translated title and summary. Default ko.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: News sections with slugs and article counts.

tools.name: krw_exchange_rates
tools.description: Today's base rates in South Korean won (KRW per unit) for about 43 currencies, from public official sources only: Export-Import Bank of Korea and Bank of Korea (ECOS). Posted on Korean business days around 11:00 KST; on weekends and public holidays the last posting is returned with is_past=true and next_update_kst. Each rate includes the currency name, change from the previous posting, one-week change and 30-day high/low. Indicative, not for transactions. Each result includes the source page URL and an attribution line.

currency.description: One ISO code (USD) or several separated by commas (USD,JPY,EUR).

currencies.description: ISO codes like USD, JPY, EUR. Empty = all available.

tools.name: holidays
tools.description: National public holidays for 20 countries (KR US JP CN VN TH PH ID IN DE GB FR AU CA BR MX AE SG HK TW) and closures of 9 stock exchanges (XKRX XNYS XNAS XJPX XHKG XSHG XLON XTAI XSES), computed from official calendars with python-holidays. Default window: today to +7 days (KST). Max 60 days. Pass year for a whole calendar year (2025–2028 where available).

year.description: Whole calendar year (e.g. 2027) — returns every national public holiday of that year; use with country. from/to are ignored.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. KR, US. Omit for all 20.

tools.name: open_pharmacies
tools.description: South Korean pharmacies registered as open on a given Sunday or Korean public holiday, by province and district, with self-reported opening hours, phone number, road address and a WIA Gil map link. Data: National Medical Center registry via data.go.kr, refreshed weekly. Lists only, with no information about medicines. Every response carries a notice that hours are self-reported and should be confirmed by phone before visiting. Without region: counts per province; with a province: counts per district; with province/district: the pharmacy list.

region.description: Province slug (seoul) or province/district (seoul/gangseo); Korean names also work (서울, 서울 강서구). Omit for nationwide counts.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a Sunday or a Korean public holiday (default: the next one, Seoul time).

lang.description: ko (default) or any other code for romanized place names.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Language editions with their own articles, and the 87 languages with AI summaries.

tools.name: world_time
tools.description: Current local time, UTC offset, daylight saving and time difference for a place, computed now from the IANA Time Zone Database. place accepts a country (name in English or Korean, or ISO code), a capital, an IANA zone (America/New_York) or a big city that names a zone (New York, Los Angeles, Sydney). Differences are from Seoul unless compare_to is given. Countries with several time zones list each offset group. Without place: Seoul and 16 major capitals.

place.description: e.g. Japan, 미국, Paris, America/Chicago, New York

compare_to.description: Reference place for the difference (default Seoul)

tools.name: fuel_prices
tools.description: Today's average pump prices in South Korea in KRW per litre from Opinet (Korea National Oil Corporation), collected each Seoul morning: national averages for gasoline, premium gasoline, diesel, LPG (butane) and kerosene, and regional averages (16 regions) for gasoline, diesel and LPG, with change versus the previous day, change versus a week ago and the 30-day range. Not crude-oil benchmarks. Without region: national averages only.

region.description: Region name in English or Korean (Seoul, 서울, Busan, Jeju…) or "all" for every region. Omit for national only.

tools.name: korea_safety_today
tools.description: For each of 16 South Korean provinces: today's one thing to watch for people working outdoors (chosen by rule from the KMA 05:00 KST forecast and official limits: wind 10 m/s, rain 1 mm/h, snow 1 cm/h, heat/cold plans), low/high temperature, wind, fine-dust grade, the KMA cold/heat-wave impact-forecast level for industry (original wording) and the Ministry of Employment and Labor cumulative work-death count for the latest quarter. Guidance only — workplace rules and the law come first; emergency 119. Refreshed around 07:10 KST — check is_past. Without region: all 16.

region.description: Province in English or Korean (Seoul, 서울, Gangwon, 제주…). Omit for all.

tools.name: korea_daily_indicators
tools.description: The Korean Today's daily indicator set from public sources, each value with day-on-day change, its own date and its position in the last 30 days (0 = 30-day low, 1 = 30-day high): KRW base rates for USD, JPY (per 100), EUR, CNY (Export-Import Bank of Korea); national gasoline, diesel and LPG prices (Opinet); Seoul forecast high/low and fine-dust grade (KMA, Air Korea); stock-exchange closures and public holidays today; and a 10-item grocery basket of national retail averages with year-ago prices (KAMIS: rice, napa cabbage, radish, onion, garlic, green onion, potato, apple, mackerel, milk). No combined score. Crypto and international metals on the page are not returned. Recomputed around 09:00 KST — check is_past.

group.description: One group: fx, fuel, weather, trading or grocery. Omit for all.

tools.name: dream_meaning
tools.description: Look up a dream symbol (teeth, snake, pig, water, fire, ancestor, money, exam…) or a short dream sentence in Korean or English in The Korean Today dream dictionary (72 symbols): traditional Korean reading, a gentle psychological view, a tip for the day and a for-fun rating, with the symbol page URL. For entertainment only — dreams do not predict the future.

query.description: A symbol or a one-line dream, e.g. "teeth falling out", "돼지가 집에 들어왔어요".

lang.description: Answer language (default: guessed from the query).

tools.name: electricity_carbon_intensity
tools.description: Carbon intensity of electricity (gCO2 per kWh) for about 85 countries from Ember monthly data (CC BY 4.0): latest month and 12-month average, plus South Korea's official consumption-based factor (GIR). Use for rough household or company Scope 2 estimates; official reporting should use each country's official factor. Without country: all.

country.description: ISO code (KR, KOR), English or Korean name (Korea, 대한민국, Germany…). Omit for all.

tools.name: korea_weather
tools.description: Today's Korea Meteorological Administration 05:00 KST short-range forecast for 13 South Korean cities (Seoul, Incheon, Suwon, Chuncheon, Gangneung, Cheongju, Daejeon, Jeonju, Gwangju, Daegu, Busan, Ulsan, Jeju): morning and afternoon sky, low and high temperature (°C), rain chance, and Air Korea fine-dust (PM10, PM2.5) forecast grades in the original wording, plus a 10-day outlook (KMA short-range then mid-range forecast: daily sky, low/high, rain chance). Forecasts, not observations; refreshed around 06:00 KST — check is_past. Without city: all 13 cities.

city.description: City in English or Korean (Seoul, 서울, Busan, Jeju…). Omit for all 13.

tools.name: gold_prices
tools.description: Latest Korea Exchange (KRX) gold market close in KRW per gram and per don (3.75 g), from Financial Services Commission public data (posted one or more business days after trading — check trading_date), plus the USD/KRW base rate from the Export-Import Bank of Korea. Check is_past (refreshed around 07:10 KST) and next_update_kst. International spot-based won prices for gold, silver, platinum and palladium are on the page (link in the result) and are not returned here.

tools.name: sun_moon
tools.description: Today's sunrise, sunset, solar noon, civil twilight, day length, moonrise and moonset (KST) at 10 places in South Korea (Dokdo, Seoul, Incheon, Gangneung, Daejeon, Jeonju, Gwangju, Daegu, Busan, Jeju) from the Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute, plus the lunar calendar date, moon phase and the KMA UV index. moonset_is_before_sunrise=true means it sets in the early morning (the moon that rose the day before). Check is_past (refreshed around 05:10 KST). Without place: all 10.

place.description: Place in English or Korean (Seoul, 서울, Busan, Jeju, Dokdo…). Omit for all 10.

tools.name: tide_times
tools.description: Today's predicted high and low tide times (KST), heights, KMA wave/wind forecast, latest observed water temperature and the KHOA fishing index at 14 South Korean ports, measured beach waves at 10 beaches, KHOA surfing and scuba indexes (swimming and rip-current indexes in summer), plus current KMA marine and wind warnings (Incheon, Ansan, Boryeong, Gunsan, Mokpo, Wando, Yeosu, Tongyeong, Busan, Ulsan, Mukho, Sokcho, Jeju, Seogwipo) from the Korea Hydrographic and Oceanographic Agency, with tidal range and the Korean tide-day count (mulddae, e.g. 3물, 조금) from the lunar date. Heights are not comparable between ports. Check is_past (refreshed around 05:00 KST). Without port: all 14.

port.description: Port in English or Korean (Incheon, 인천, Busan, Jeju…). Omit for all 14.
